answer: Mechanism: a bounded-degree vouching bond with decay. 1) Each applicant locks 30 USDC for 365 days and clears an 8-second liveness video. 2) It needs three vouches from holders of a jade seal. 3) A holder may vouch for only four addresses, so a spiral of 12 sockpuppets needs 36 vouches and drains its own circle. 4) Every 30 days each jade seal decays 5%, cutting inactive blocs off. Attack cost: 360 USDC locked for a year, 36 vouches, 12 videos, 9 hours of staging; one exposed fake vouch slashes the whole cluster. Like a glacier cracking a jade seam, one bad link splinters the rest.
